label: sec:braid-involutions
html: The three-strand braid group B_3 admits two structural involutions that govern discrete symmetries of the particle dictionary: the outer diagram flip \tau(\sigma_1) = \sigma_2, which exchanges the two crossing slots, and conjugation by the Garside half-twist \Delta_3 = \sigma_1\sigma_2\sigma_1. Pairing these involutions with the cyclic Lagrange resolvent transform diagonalizes the C_3 holonomy action on the trefoil and prepares the charge-conjugation and spin-parity involutions used in the particle chapters.
